title: Sending Charcoal in Snowy Weather
synopsis: What does this Chinese idiom mean, and how is it applicable to the world today?

fullText.simplified:
雪中送炭

    宋朝的时候，有一年冬天风雪漫天，气候严寒。宋太宗穿着狐狸皮外套，坐在温暖的屋子里还觉得冷。他想：“这么冷的天气，皇宫里尚且如此，外面那些没有衣服和柴火的百姓一定更难熬。”所以他马上命令大臣准备衣服、食物和木炭，送到那些贫寒的百姓手中。人们解决了衣食之忧，得到了木炭生火取暖，非常感动，纷纷称颂皇帝。于是，历史上便留下了“雪中送炭”的佳话。
     “雪中送炭”的意思是，在下雪的时候，给别人送炭，让他烧火取暖。比喻在别人特别需要帮助的时候，给以物质上的帮助或者精神上的关怀。
    你可以这么用：2020年，新冠肺炎疫情在中国爆发之后，许多国家政府和国际组织向中国伸出了援助之手，以种种形式支援和帮助中国，为中国提供了许多防控疫情的物资。这种在抗击疫情中守望相助的表现，真是“雪中送炭”啊！
fullText.traditional:
雪中送炭

    宋朝的時候，有一年冬天風雪漫天，氣候嚴寒。宋太宗穿著狐狸皮外套，坐在溫暖的屋子裡還覺得冷。他想：“這麼冷的天氣，皇宮裡尚且如此，外面那些沒有衣服和柴火的百姓一定更難熬。”所以他馬上命令大臣準備衣服、食物和木炭，送到那些貧寒的百姓手中。人們解決了衣食之憂，得到了木炭生火取暖，非常感動，紛紛稱頌皇帝。於是，歷史上便留下了“雪中送炭”的佳話。
     “雪中送炭”的意思是，在下雪的時候，給別人送炭，讓他燒火取暖。比喻在別人特別需要幫助的時候，給以物質上的幫助或者精神上的關懷。
    你可以這麼用：2020年，新冠肺炎疫情在中國爆發之後，許多國家政府和國際組織向中國伸出了援助之手，以種種形式支援和幫助中國，為中國提供了許多防控疫情的物資。這種在抗擊疫情中守望相助的表現，真是“雪中送炭”啊！

raw.synopsis: What does this Chinese idiom mean, and how is it applicable to the world today?
sentence_translations: One winter during the Song dynasty, the snow filled the skies and the weather was bitterly cold.
Emperor Taizong of Song was wearing a fox fur coat and sitting in a warm room, yet he still felt cold.
He thought, “The weather is so cold that it’s like this even inside the imperial palace.
It must be all the more difficult for the common people outside who don’t have clothes or firewood.”
So, he immediately ordered his ministers to prepare clothing, food, and charcoal to deliver to the poor common people.
This took care of the people’s worries about food and clothing, and they received charcoal to light fires and keep warm.
They were very touched, and one after another praised the emperor.
Thus, the widely told tale of “sending charcoal in snowy weather” got its place in history.
“Sending charcoal in snowy weather” means delivering charcoal to others when it’s snowing, ..
.. allowing them to start a fire and keep warm.
It is an analogy for giving people material assistance or moral support when they are really in need of help.
You can use it like this: in 2020, after the COVID-19 epidemic exploded in China ..
.. many national governments and international organizations extended a helping hand to China.
They supported and assisted China in all kinds of ways, ..
.. providing China with many supplies to prevent and control the spread of the disease.
These acts of mutual help and protection in fighting the epidemic are truly instances of “sending charcoal in snowy weather”!
